subject: Film & Cinema
title: Foreshadowing and Payoff
description: A fast breakdown of Foreshadowing and Payoff for builders.

hook.text: Chekhov said: if a gun hangs on the wall in act one, it must fire by act three.

buildup.text: Foreshadowing plants details early that become meaningful later in the story.

discovery.text: The payoff rewards attentive audiences and makes the story feel inevitable.

twist.text: Plant without payoff is frustrating. Payoff without setup is cheating.

climax.text: The Sixth Sense's twist works because every earlier scene contains hidden clues.

punchline.text: Great endings are hidden in plain sight.

quiz.question: What is Chekhov's gun principle?
options: Every element introduced must eventually serve the story
